frozenQuestions: Is Immediate Selector Entry fixed-horizon return positive after the existing canonical cost?
At which of 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes does economic alpha exist?
How does return change after fixed 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 minute entry delays?
Does the Frozen Selector add value over like-for-like Random Top5 and Simple Momentum Top5?
Does model-free decay explain why prior Entry research converged to Immediate?

execution.entry: first saved regular-session 5m OPEN at or after selector decision plus intended delay; missing first eligible bar fails closed; no same-bar future HIGH/LOW
execution.exit: saved completed 5m CLOSE exactly at the fixed target timestamp; no interpolation, forward-fill, next-price substitution, lunch crossing substitution or auction repair

cost.canonicalSource: existing Candidate A and LONG integration cost contract

statistics.pointEstimate: row-weighted mean plus separately reported session-equal mean

policies.P1: observe first 5m completed CLOSE; if close < decisionPrice enter next OPEN (+5), otherwise mandatory fallback at +10 OPEN; unknown condition also mandatory fallback at +10 OPEN

verdictRules.selectorPositive: At least one of 10m, 15m or 30m Immediate canonical-net horizons has mean >= 0.10pp, cluster-CI lower > 0, PF > 1, and paired incremental cluster-CI lower > 0 versus both canonical Random and Momentum at the same horizon.
verdictRules.selectorNegative: All evaluable 10m, 15m and 30m Immediate canonical-net horizon cluster-CI uppers are < 0.
verdictRules.selectorNotDemonstrated: No primary horizon has positive canonical-net point estimate and no positive rule is met.
verdictRules.selectorWeakOrUncertain: Any remaining outcome, including positive point estimates without the positive rule.
verdictRules.delayedEntrySupported: At selector-terminal 30m, one precommitted nonzero delay improves canonical net over delay0 by >= 0.10pp with paired cluster-CI lower > 0.
verdictRules.immediateEntrySupported: Delayed Entry is not supported, delay0 has the highest selector-terminal 30m point estimate, and at least one nonzero delay has paired cluster-CI upper < 0 versus delay0.
verdictRules.noTimingEdgeDemonstrated: Neither delayed nor immediate support rule is met with adequate coverage.
verdictRules.inconclusiveTiming: Terminal30 evaluable sessions < 38 or observed 80%-power MDE exceeds 0.20pp.

savedDevelopmentArtifacts.providerAccess: download and decrypt immutable saved artifacts only
